name: Ágach
text: Ágach, contentious or warlike in Irish, was one of the Fomorians. MacKillop reads the form as a named member of the divine-hostile side in the mythic wars of the Tuatha Dé. The principal record sits under the Fomorians headword.

attributes.attribute: Fomorian enemy of the Tuatha Dé Danann; the contentious one

okr.objective: Ágach is a MacKillop signpost to Fomorians.
key_results: Cites Fomorians as the canonical headword.
Enemy of the Tuatha Dé Danann.
